entities.name: Herbert Silberer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Herbert Silberer was an Austrian psychoanalyst involved with the professional circle surrounding Sigmund Freud which included other pioneers of psychological study as Carl Gustav Jung, Alfred Adler and others. He had a background in athletics and sports journalism.
